method: Original Nogova R01WarCry mission through existing native Windows Vulkan developer harness. Copied profiles, --nosound, synchronization validation,1920x1080,auto/TAA100%,one bounce,RT sun/cloud shadows,AO/water/volumetrics off. Eight original-placement front/back views with9:00 and17:30 PBRoff/auto-GIoff/auto-GIon matrices; advancing-simulation translated/turned cameras for sign and both fence variants; fence distance retreats0/8/22/52/92m.
limits: Developer-camera gameplay observations, not physical traversal, Steam launch or mission completion. On labels mean triPBR auto, the existing mode enabling exact-model regions. Family/frame receiver counters include neighboring terrain/buildings and are not target masks. Both accepted sources have receiver family0; no new native or CPU reception. The sign daylight lobe is nearly invisible in the sampled direction; its dusk change is subtle. No claim of measured optics, recovered albedo, galvanized substrate or separate photographed-fastener material. TAA/foliage/exposure differences preclude whole-frame pixel identity between separate Vulkan runs.

appearance.signposts: Worn dark/light photograph remains legible; subtle view-dependent dusk lobe, without a new post-side/cap seam. Board lettering/opacity and unshaded source remain original. Separate canonical/alias end-marker control retained.
appearance.fences: Mild daylight response and a visible warmer sun-facing dusk panel. Back faces remain cool/shaded at dusk. No new diagonal/within-panel lighting cuts, support-boundary discontinuity, silhouette change or movement trail observed. Photographed ribs, seams, screws and wear remain original artwork. Separate support/hardware triangles, authored207 vertices and excluded faces remain gated; photographs of fasteners are not independently reconstructed.

costMethod: RTX4060Ti/NVIDIA617.14; matched native1080p scene workloads, probes off. Warm10; GI Off/On/On/Off; settle4/sample6; mean of paired interval medians.
